summary: Phase 2 backend testing complete. Added 13 new pytest cases (test_bir_phase2.py) covering POST /api/admin/run-reminders (RBAC + report shape + dedup + result_status='disabled' verification with empty RESEND_API_KEY) and the new GET /api/forms/{filing_id}/export.xml + export.pdf endpoints (auth gate, 404 unknown, 404 cross-user, content-type, content-disposition, magic bytes, structural assertions). Combined with the 30 Phase 1 tests, full suite is 43/43 passing — zero regressions. APScheduler 'daily 09:00 Asia/Manila' job confirmed started in supervisor backend logs on every backend boot.
critical_code_review_comments: scheduler.py: dedup_key correctly composed of (user_id, form_type, period, days_until); reminders_sent insert happens for sent/disabled/error but NOT for skipped_duplicates — verified by counting docs before/after two consecutive runs.
scheduler.py: respects REMINDER_DAYS={30,7,1} window and excludes already-submitted filings via db.filings status='submitted' lookup — good.

email_service.send_email returns {'status':'disabled'} when RESEND_API_KEY is empty; reminders_sent rows for the entire test database confirmed to contain zero result_status='sent' entries while the key is empty (only 'disabled' allowed).

exports.py XML: <eBIRFormsFiling> root with formType+period+generatedAt attributes and Header/Body/Computation/Summary children parsed cleanly via xml.etree.ElementTree. TIN, classification, VAT flag, line of business mirrored from business_profiles. Numeric Computation fields correctly tagged type='currency' with .2f formatting.

exports.py PDF: reportlab Letter-size build returns a >1500 byte buffer starting with %PDF-1.4 magic bytes. Content-Disposition attaches with .pdf filename. Filing rows lookup is scoped by user_id so cross-user access correctly returns 404.

server.py: lifespan wires start_scheduler(db) on startup and stop_scheduler() on shutdown; supervisor backend log line 'APScheduler started: daily 09:00 Asia/Manila reminder job.' present every restart.

Minor — scheduler.py reminder writes both 'disabled' and 'error' results into reminders_sent which makes dedup also block retries when Resend is later activated. Acceptable for MVP, but worth a follow-up: only insert dedup row on 'sent' (or add a TTL/retry field) so users still receive a reminder once email becomes enabled. Currently only matters once RESEND_API_KEY flips from empty → set.
Minor — exports.py response uses fastapi.Response with bytes (good); could optionally stream very large PDFs via StreamingResponse, but current sizes are <50KB so this is fine.

Phase 1 carry-over: backend/.env FRONTEND_URL still points at a stale preview host (8d9e0af4-…) different from the active REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (bir-filer.preview.emergentagent.com). Doesn't break backend tests, but credentialed browser cookies from the active UI host could fail CORS — recommend syncing FRONTEND_URL to the active frontend origin.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@birfilipino.app / Admin@2026 (auto-seeded). Phase 2 tests register fresh TEST_*@example.com freelancer sessions per module.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed users with random UUIDs (graduated freelancer + two cross-user verifiers). One 1701Q filing generated per run for export tests. reminders_sent rows are inserted by /admin/run-reminders only when a deadline currently sits at exactly 30/7/1 days out — on the test day no such deadline exists so all counters were 0 and dedup behaviour was verified via document-count delta + repeat-run skipped_duplicates >= first-run inserts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at https://bir-filer.preview.emergentagent.com is fully working; 43/43 pytest cases green (test_bir_backend.py + test_bir_phase2.py). APScheduler daily 09:00 Asia/Manila job logged on every backend startup. RESEND_API_KEY remains empty by design — email send is no-op and reminders_sent.result_status='disabled'. Mock billing also still in place. If RESEND_API_KEY is later populated, expect dedup rows for previous 'disabled' attempts to suppress retry — see code-review note. Phase 1 FRONTEND_URL/CORS mismatch in backend/.env still unresolved (low priority, only impacts browser credentialed flow).
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All 8 review-request bullets verified: (1) RBAC on /run-reminders ✅ (401 unauth, 403 user, 200 admin with full report shape). (2) Dedup ✅ — second run of /run-reminders adds zero new reminders_sent rows and skipped_duplicates >= first-run inserts. (3) result_status='disabled' (never 'sent') while RESEND_API_KEY empty ✅. (4) export.xml structure ✅ — root <eBIRFormsFiling>, Header/Body/Computation/Summary children, application/xml + attachment .xml header. (5) export.pdf binary ✅ — %PDF-1.4 magic, application/pdf, attachment .pdf, 1.5KB+. (6) export 401/404/cross-user-404 ✅. (7) Phase 1 regression ✅ — 30/30 still green. (8) APScheduler startup log ✅ in supervisor logs.
